## Nossa empresa

Shipwell is a US-based logistics and supply chain platform focused on transportation management. The company builds technology that helps shippers, carriers and brokers manage freight operations end to end on a single platform.

## Descrição da vaga

We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to design, build and scale the Python services that power Shipwell's transportation management platform. This is a senior individual contributor role, fully remote from Brazil, working closely with a distributed engineering team.

- Design, build and maintain backend services and APIs in Python
- Model and evolve data structures that support high volume logistics workflows
- Write automated tests and contribute to code quality standards across the codebase
- Review pull requests and mentor mid level engineers on backend best practices
- Collaborate with product, frontend and data teams to scope and deliver features
- Monitor, debug and optimize performance and reliability of production systems
- Participate in technical discussions and help shape backend architecture decisions

## Local

Fully Remote 

## Requisitos

- Solid professional experience as a backend engineer working primarily with Python
- Strong experience building and consuming RESTful APIs
- Proficiency with relational databases and SQL, including query optimization
- Experience with cloud environments and containerized deployments
- Familiarity with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines and version control workflows
- Ability to work autonomously in a distributed, asynchronous team
- Professional English, written and spoken, for daily collaboration with a US based team

## Benefícios

Fully remote, based in Brazil
Working hours with overlap to US time zones

## Contratação

PJ

## Como se candidatar

Você pode se candidatar pelo link: https://combineglobalrecruitment.na.teamtailor.com/jobs/653633-full-stack-developer-python-react

### Nível



- Pleno
- Sênior


### Regime

- PJ
- Contrato

- Remoto

gh_80974dc524046caf9e939cc1.title: 🛠 Senior Front-End Engineer (🇺🇸 Full-Remote) 🚀
gh_80974dc524046caf9e939cc1.description:
**Who We Are**

We are a rapidly growing software technology startup from Silicon Valley, founded by top engineers from Stanford and MIT.

Our dynamic team brings together extensive experience and diverse backgrounds in finance and consulting from New York, San Francisco, and Chicago.

As a fully remote company, we offer a unique opportunity for exceptional individuals to join our team. We foster a culture that values both practicality and creativity, providing an meritocratic environment for you to showcase your skills and contribute to the creation of innovative products.

🍏 New Graduates welcomed to apply! We have positions for all experience levels.

🇺🇸 Non-Native English speaking team members welcomed. Only basic reading English ability needed.

[APPLY NOW](https://linktr.ee/growaha)

As our Front-End Engineer, you are tasked with the development of engaging, intuitive, and visually compelling user interfaces for our web app product. You will work in close collaboration with designers and back-end engineers, and the marketing team, transmuting design mockups, user stories, and wireframes into high-quality code, thereby ensuring an immersive and seamless user experience.

## **Your Journey as a Front-End Engineer**

- Our front-end ecosystem is fortified with **TypeScript.**
    - React, and Material UI (MUI)
    - React Native for mobile front-end development.
- As front-end engineers, we take pride in precise design execution, valuing pixel-perfect implementation and employing Figma to maintain alignment with original designs.
- Collaborative work culture is our ethos.
    - Work in tandem with a cross-functional team through the development cycle, from front-end frameworks, and front-end service design to deployment.
    - Engage in code reviews to elevate your work and that of your colleagues.
    - Write clean, reusable, and testable code for easy maintenance by yourself and your fellow software engineers.
    - Partner with engineers from various teams to create user-delighting features.
    - Collaborate with our design team to understand and address user pain points.
    - Drive enhancements in engineering standards, tooling, and processes.
    - Develop new tools for internal teams.
    - Embrace ownership and accountability for your work.
- API integration is a critical part of your role.
    - Integrate APIs according to spec with front-end frameworks.
- Build, mange, and reuse UI components effectively.
    - Keep UI components organized.
    - Reuse UI component to maximize efficiency, robustness, and user experience.
- Troubleshooting and debugging are indispensable skills.
    - Investigate, debug, and upgrade existing software systems, including the development and integration of new components or automation pipelines as needed.
    - Address production issues across services.
- Engage in the regular launch of new markets, features, or products.

## **What You Bring**

1. Degree in Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related field.
2. Five or more years of coding experience or a similar role internship.
3. Proficiency in web development frameworks, especially JavaScript, React, and Material UI (MUI).
4. Experience with databases like PostgreSQL and SQL Server.
5. Familiarity with quality control testing using tools such as QUnit, Mocha, Jasmine, or RSpec.

With your craftsmanship, you'll help to shape the user interface of our software, driving our mission forward through stunning visual experiences. Are you ready to create?

[APPLY NOW](https://linktr.ee/growaha)

gh_8005b1f69f3281410b696d21.description:
## 團隊簡介/地點

QuestDB is the fastest open-source time-series database. The team is completely remote. 

## 工作內容

As a Core Database Engineer, you will bring your experience in design, development, and testing to improve our open source time series SQL database. You will continuously improve the system's performance, ensuring that QuestDB remains scalable and easy to use as we roll out new features built with C++ and Java (zero-GC). You will have the opportunity to interact with and gather feedback from QuestDB's growing community of users and contributors. You'll have the chance to work in an open and collaborative environment to improve user experience and the system's consistency along the way.

## 能力需求

- 全英文工作環境，聽說讀寫流利，可討論技術話題
- 3+ years of experience building data-centric software, writing and performance tuning data processing algorithms
- A BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience
- Proficiency in programming languages such as Core Java, C, or C++
- Good understanding of data structures, algorithms, OS inner-workings, and hardware
- Can-do attitude, good communication skills, empathy
- Solid experience working as part of a team, knowledge of git workflow, CI, and code review process

### 加分

- Cloud experience is a plus

## 薪資範圍

- 大約落在年薪七萬到十萬 英鎊，但不限於這個範圍
- 股票選擇權

## 工時/特休

- 彈性可談，年休一般是25起跳

可線上申請
